text: **Fix found in the real Artifact (artifact_ui.js v4, patch v8, attached).** Clicking a SharePoint file link opened the reader window AND the file in a browser tab: claude.ai's frame opens a link's `href` itself, whatever the page's capture listener does (`preventDefault` + `stopImmediatePropagation` were not enough). Now a file link keeps no `href`: a MutationObserver moves it to `data-sp-href` (role=link, keyboard Enter works), and only the window opens; the window's "Open in SharePoint" button is the one real link left. Offline test checks the link has no href and the window still reads pages 1 and 2. Lesson for any Artifact page: a link you want to handle in the page must not carry an href.
